ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast; approximately 92% of visible fluke surface consists of low-intensity pixels (< 50 on 8-bit scale), with high-intensity pixels (> 200) isolated to localized linear/circular anomalies and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous field (dark gray/black); localized high-intensity geometric clusters (scratches and spots) mapped across both lobes; significant high-intensity irregular masses concentrated at the terminal distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped indentation at the vertical midline; approximate angle of 115 degrees with a bounding box depth of approximately 8% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (2-15 pixel variance) along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge, well-isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a moderately convex sweep from the medial notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete circular high-contrast pixel clusters (3-12 pixel diameter) distributed across the ventral plane; substantial high-relief, high-intensity masses at the terminal points of both lobes corresponding to biological growth.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous intersecting linear high-intensity disruptions (scars/rake marks) ranging from 20 to 200 pixels in length, exhibiting higher density on the viewer-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring patterns across the entire visible ventral surface and significant calcified/biological protrusions (barnacles) on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Active water turbulence and specular highlights at the lower-central insertion point partially obscuring the fluke-peduncle transition.
